hero.subline: METIS designs evidence-based programs for civic education, media literacy, and democratic resilience in Germany and Europe.

items.title: Civic Education
items.description: We promote understanding of constitutional values and democratic institutions in Germany and Europe through practical educational programs.

items.title: Media Literacy
items.description: We build critical thinking skills for navigating digital media and disinformation — fostering an informed and resilient society.

items.title: Attitude Research
items.description: We study shifts in democratic attitudes among the population and provide evidence-based foundations for political action.

items.title: Constitution in the Classroom
items.description: Teaching modules for schools covering the Basic Law, fundamental rights, and European values — co-developed with educators.

items.title: Digital Citizenship
items.description: Workshops and online materials for critically evaluating news sources and understanding algorithmic influence.

items.title: Democracy Barometer
items.description: Annual survey on democratic attitudes and trust in state institutions among the German electorate.

kontakt.title: Contact
kontakt.description: Would you like to collaborate with us or have questions about our programs? We look forward to hearing from you.
